review.scale: 0 = unusable; 5 = playable with substantial friction; 7 = solid and usable with clear shortcomings; 10 = exceptional across assessed mobile experience. Scores judge observed interaction and communication, not win/loss.

reasons: Tap-to-aim and simultaneous route/fire made the mission manageable with two contacts.
Large fixed buttons and route recovery reduce touch precision demands.
Small or partly covered coil targets were inconsistent to acquire; threat turning while travelling remained awkward.
Receiver recovery, phased coils and final deck hold provided a readable progression and a recoverable arc.
Second attempt benefited from learned release/repress and retarget behavior.
Combat often became stationary sustained fire across armor cycles; rear pressure was harder to address than the primary objective.
Cohesive rain-soaked station, cyan/amber visual language, weapon view and terminal screens.
Large signage and distinct receiver and coil structures gave the compact level identity.
Dark structures and busy combat overlays reduced some target separation.
Concise visible handbook, paused planning map, route line, resupply and clear terminal choice were helpful.
Release-after-save was learnable but easy to miss while holding a contact; lingering left the player exposed.
DASH taking over route required another press; multi-tasking under rear fire was demanding.
Objectives, health/ammo, coil OFF states, upload percentage and result headline read clearly at 844x390.
Handbook and terminal telemetry are compact; thin tiny uppercase lines require closer inspection.
In-scene coil numbers/edges were harder to distinguish than their status panel.

helpful_moments: Opening guard instruction immediately matched a successful action.
Map showed recovered checkmarks and remaining receiver route without mission pressure.
Receiver resupply recovered a damaged run.
Coil OFF panel and upload IN ZONE indicator removed outcome ambiguity.
frustrating_moments: Holding at a saved receiver while threats attacked from behind.
Narrow coil tap produced no useful visible retargeting.
Ammunition spent while armor was closed or target already off.
Loss after defeating all coils because return-to-deck pressure arrived from multiple angles.
review.scope_of_judgment: Holistic grade of these two assisted emulated landscape attempts only. No claim of enjoyment for unassessed content or of continuous-session enjoyment.

limitations: Synthetic native-CDP touch in paused Chromium emulation at 844x390; captures pause for inspection and allow more deliberation than continuous play.
Software-WebGL fallback reported by helper; renderer not certified.
Physical phones, Safari, audio, tactile thumb reach, hardware performance, battery/thermal behavior and continuous enjoyment remain unassessed.
No manual movement-stick travel, FIRE drag aiming, AIM slow correction, JUMP/VAULT, settings adjustments, memory-reading screen or full tactical handbook assessed.
Source hash is user-provided frozen identity; no source inspection or hash verification performed. Visible BUILD 95 matches expected title.
No game source, tests, docs, prior reviews, recordings, internal state or target metadata inspected. Help was the only helper content read; review used current screenshots and visible UI fields.
